parsed.rationale: All six members are empty type-alias-object declarations (fields_or_signature: []) that serve as SwiftUI @main entry-point aliases in structurally unrelated targets: WXUISampleApp, WallpaperSampleApp, PlayerHeaderViewApp, PlayerHeaderViewSampleApp, WatchXYC, and WXYCTVApp. Each alias exists solely to name the top-level App struct for its own executable target; the structural similarity (shared_field_count: 1, all other differing_slots: null) is an artefact of every SwiftUI app needing exactly one such declaration. Merging or extracting them would be meaningless because each must remain in its own module as the @main entry point. The coincidence is purely structural with no shared domain concept to unify.
